title: LeetCode Archive
oneLiner: Every problem solved, backed up the moment it is accepted.
claim: A continuous sync from the LeetCode account into a repository, so the archive never drifts from what was actually submitted.

metrics: Solutions stored per problem directory, keyed by the platform problem id
Backed up by the SyncLeet extension, so the push happens on acceptance rather than by hand
proof.architecture: The browser extension reads accepted submissions from LeetCode and writes them into a repository with one directory per problem. Nothing is copied by hand, which is the only way an archive stays honest.
